content.title: Coachella 2026 Livestream to Features All Seven Stages, 4K Resolution
content.text: Coachella is back starting this weekend, and so too is the festival’s acclaimed YouTube livestream. This year, the festival is livestreaming all seven of its seven stages simultaneously, with the Coachella Stage, Outdoor Theatre, and Sahara available in 4K. Additionally, the Quasar stage can be viewed in both horizontal and vertical formats. Viewers will also have the option to stream up to four performances simultaneously in a 4×4 grid multi-view format. Get Last-Minute Coachella 2026 Tickets Here In between live performances, Coachella TV will broadcast archival moments from festivals’ past. The livestream will be available on Coachella’s YouTube channel and livestream app, with coverage beginning daily at 7:00 p.m. ET / 4:00 p.m. PT. Update: Check out the complete livestream schedule below. A majority of this year’s performers are featured, including headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G, and Anyma, plus The Strokes, Iggy Pop, Nine Inch Noize, Turnstile, Clipse, The xx, Addison Rae, Interpol, Disclosure, and BIGBANG.
